records.real_world_identity_notes: MINI Countryman built to FIA Supercar regulations for the World Rallycross Championship. The project began at Prodrive, which intended to run the car in 2014 but did not secure a driver; JRM Racing bought it at the end of 2014 and campaigned it from 2015. Derived from the MINI John Cooper Works WRC and reported at around 480 bhp from a 1.6-litre BMW turbo. CONFIRM: no source consulted states its gearbox, so the sequential comes from the cockpit rather than a specification.
records.confidence_basis: Controls observed live with automatic clutch and shifting disabled. CONFIRM the real-world identity source before promotion.
